label: Some necessary concrete being at w has a power for the actual contingent concreta's joint absence
paraphrase: Conclusion of the sibling route: some concrete candidate exists at w, exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2 de re) and has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w (one world lacking them all). It asserts no uniqueness, simplicity, firstness, intellect or God, and nothing about the power's exercise.
